title: Selecting FAST’s Second Branch Distance
summary: For ell greater than two, FAST chooses w near the square root of ell, but selecting the second branch distance w′ amid diffusion and performance constraints remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine an appropriate $w'$ as a function of $(\ell,w)$ that preserves security and performance.

scope.domain: Branch-distance parameter selection for the FAST format-preserving encryption construction.
parameters: ell: parameter governing the branch-distance setting
w: parameter chosen near the square root of ell
w′: second branch distance subject to diffusion and performance tradeoffs
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine how to select w′ in relation to ell and w under the competing diffusion and performance considerations.

citations.label: FAST: Secure and High Performance Format-Preserving Encryption and Tokenization

progress.summary: The source explicitly asks how to select w′. It places the question amid competing diffusion and performance constraints, with w chosen near the square root of ell when ell is greater than two.
citation_labels: F. Betül Durak et al., FAST: Secure and High Performance Format-Preserving Encryption and Tokenization
